Each section opens with the record's reproduction headline and any usage
warning ([label definitions](../eos-labels.md)), then the scope and basis of
the stored check. Only recorded content is shown: missing selections, weights,
errors or conventions are unknown, not zero, and are not inferred. Generating
this page fits nothing and changes no classification or source coefficient.
Every record is also listed by identifier in the
[numerical ledger](../primary-eos-refits.md#records), its
[machine-readable form](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/docs/data/primary-eos-refits.json) and the
[source-audit reports](../source-audits.md).

**Curves and residuals** replay the full stored source and reconstructed
coefficients on the same recorded audit inputs. Residual = model − input in
the fitted quantity's native units; for pressure, P(model) − P(input) at each
input volume and temperature (isothermal records use their reference
temperature). RMS is an unweighted descriptive error, not a parameter
uncertainty or the weighted fitting objective. With more than five
temperatures, the minimum, middle and maximum isotherms are drawn; residuals
include every selected row. Error bars appear only where all widths are
recoverable and keep the source meaning, including digitization widths.
No uncertainty band is inferred.

**Coefficient graphs** show stored central values and recorded error widths
in the audit's units; each panel includes zero. They are not observation or
residual plots. Fixed/adopted values are constraints, not recovered values.
Tables round an error to two significant digits when its leading digit is 1
or 2, otherwise one, and the value to the error's decimal place; values
without a positive error show at most six significant digits. Full precision
stays in EOSMAT and the ledger.

## Chen et al. (2018), 300 K Ne-medium Vinet

**reproduced** · `ca_perovskite_tetragonal_chen_2018_vinet` · `Vinet` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/ca_perovskite_tetragonal.md#record-ca_perovskite_tetragonal_chen_2018_vinet)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Conditional parameter agreement under both the combined-error comparison and numerical similarity screen; source confidence conventions remain explicit, and unknown source confidence or shared-data covariance does not become a formal confidence test or author-workflow reproduction.

**Usage:** Use the unchanged published 300 K Vinet parameterization for qualified comparison in its measured 28.824-62.477 GPa range. V0 is an extrapolation and K0' is fixed at 4. Retain the reported 2-sigma lattice and parameter errors without inventing pressure errors or source weights. P4/mmm refinements are parallel structural diagnostics, not additional independent fit observations.

- Every compared free coefficient passes the combined-error comparison and numerical similarity screen. The source explicitly reports two-sigma parameter widths; dividing those widths by two before combining with reconstruction standard errors also passes. The printed-source-width-only cutoff is not required for this parameter-agreement scope. Original weights, calibration covariance and author workflow remain unrecovered; shared-data cross-fit covariance is unknown. Existing reconstructed errors retained; no source confidence convention inferred. Earlier audit statement (superseded only as to missing reconstruction uncertainty and the resulting numerical label): Complete source-scope table check with unresolved fitting details: all seven I4/mcm Table 1 rows are used, K0-prime is fixed at 4, and the reported Ye et al. Pt pressures are retained. The source does not publish pressure uncertainties, residual direction, weights, fit software, unrounded inputs, or covariance. The generic fit therefore uses an errors-in-variables objective with one-sigma volume errors propagated from the table's two-sigma lattice errors; the dedicated reproduction also reports unweighted pressure- and volume-residual sensitivity fits. Those diagnostics do not define a replacement EOS, and the classification is capped at similar because statistical parity cannot be established without the source weighting and pressure-error model. See docs/literature-reproductions/uncertainty-reconstruction.md for the complete conditional uncertainty budget.
- Usage recommendation: Use the unchanged published 300 K Vinet parameterization for qualified comparison in its measured 28.824-62.477 GPa range. V0 is an extrapolation and K0' is fixed at 4. Retain the reported 2-sigma lattice and parameter errors without inventing pressure errors or source weights. P4/mmm refinements are parallel structural diagnostics, not additional independent fit observations.
